sentences.en: The political scandal was brought to light by two journalists.
sentences.zh: 这起政治丑闻是由两名记者揭露的。

sentences.en: The undersecretary was maintained in office by the political bosses.
sentences.zh: 副部长被政界大佬们保留在了职位上。

sentences.en: I'm opposed to political power being monopolized within a clique.
sentences.zh: 我反对一个派系垄断政治权力。

senses.zh: 政治的，政治上的；政党的，党派的；政治性的，涉及政治的；权力斗争的，谋略的
